units.source_text: 源氏内大臣又开言道：“回想当年，并无何等可悲可恼之事，理应安闲度日。

en.t: Minister Genji spoke again: "Looking back on those days, there was nothing especially sad or troubling, and I ought to have passed my time in peace.

units.source_text: 只因我心耽好风流，以致终年忧患不绝。

en.t: It was only because my heart was absorbed in love affairs that worries and suffering never ceased throughout the years.

units.source_text: 有许多女子，我和她发生了不应该的恋爱，使我至今犹觉痛苦。

en.t: There were many women with whom I entered into loves that should never have happened, and even now they still cause me pain.

units.source_text: 其中至死不能谅解而抱恨长终者，计有二人，其一便是你家已过世的母夫人。

en.t: Among them, two never forgave me even at death and passed away bearing resentment; one of them was your late mother.

units.source_text: 她怨我薄倖，直至最后终不谅解，此乃我终身一大恨事。

en.t: She resented my faithlessness and would not forgive me to the very end; this is one of the great regrets of my life.

units.source_text: 我竭诚照顾你这遗孤，指望借此聊慰寸心。

en.t: I have cared for you, her orphaned child, with all sincerity, hoping that by doing so I might bring my heart a little comfort.

units.source_text: 无奈‘旧恨余烬犹未消’，看来这是永世的业障了。”

en.t: But alas, 'the remaining embers of old resentment have not yet gone out'; it seems this is a karmic burden for all eternity."
As for the other woman, let us leave her aside for now.

units.source_text: 话头转向他处：“中间我惨遭谪戍，常思回京之后，应做之事甚多。

en.t: He turned the conversation elsewhere: "During that time I suffered bitter exile, and I often thought that after returning to the capital there would be many things I ought to do.

units.source_text: 现在总算逐渐如愿以偿了。

en.t: Now, at last, those wishes are gradually being fulfilled.

units.source_text: 住在东院的那人，以前孤苦伶仃，现在安居纳福，无所顾虑了。

en.t: The woman living in the eastern wing was once lonely and forlorn, but now she lives peacefully, enjoys good fortune, and has nothing to worry about.

units.source_text: 这个人性情温和，我与她互相谅解，亲密无间。

en.t: She is gentle by nature, and she and I understand each other, intimate and without distance between us.

units.source_text: 我回京以后，复官晋爵，身为帝室屏藩，但我对富贵并不深感兴趣，惟有风月情怀，始终难于抑制。

en.t: After I returned to the capital, I regained office and rose in rank, serving as a bulwark of the imperial house; yet wealth and honor never deeply interested me, and only my romantic longings have always been hard to restrain.

units.source_text: 当你入宫之际，我努力抑制对你的恋情而当了你的保护人，不知你能谅解我此心否？

en.t: When you entered the palace, I struggled to suppress my love for you and became your protector; I wonder whether you can understand this heart of mine.

units.source_text: 如果你不寄予同情，我真是枉费苦心了！”

en.t: If you will not show me sympathy, then all my painstaking effort has truly been in vain!"

units.source_text: 梅壶女御觉得厌烦，默默不答。

en.t: The Umetsubo Consort felt weary of it and remained silent, giving no reply.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“你不回答，可见不同情我，我好伤心啊！”

en.t: Minister Genji said, "Since you do not answer, it is clear you have no sympathy for me. How deeply it hurts me!"
